tools.name: search_firms
tools.description: Find listed estate planning firms by place (location text, state, metro, or lat/lng with a radius), service, whether the first step can be completed online, and whether the firm publishes a price. Results include each firm's profile URL and the source of every fact. Place searches list labeled spons

tools.name: get_firm
tools.description: The full public record for one listed firm, by its slug (from search_firms or a profile URL /firms/<slug>).

tools.name: summarize_place
tools.description: The facts about estate planning firms in one place, in one call: how many are listed and reviewed, how many publish a price and the lowest and highest published amounts (each named with its firm, package and scope; never an average), which firms let you begin online, which services firms list, when

tools.name: list_places
tools.description: States with listed firms and the metro areas that have firms within 100 miles, with counts and page URLs.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: The service filters search_firms accepts, with counts across all listings that have a sourced matching service, including later additions to homepage-screened records. Services describe scope, not quality.

tools.name: recent_changes
tools.description: Firms whose whole record or a published field was checked on or after a date, newest first by latest_checked_at. checked_at remains the whole-record date; this is not value-change history. Use it to keep a copy of the data current; fetch get_firm for the current record.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_firms, get_firm, list_places · Private data: get_firm, summarize_place, list_services, recent_changes · Public sink: summarize_place.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_firms, get_firm, list_places · Private data: get_firm, summarize_place, list_services, recent_changes · Public sink: summarize_place

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
